headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with experience delivering 100+ digital and print assets and reusable brand systems for corporate communications.

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding, visual identity, typography, layout, print production, marketing creatives

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and onboarding.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders, achieving low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.

projects.name: Branding kit for AT Creation startup
bullets: Developed logo, typography, and palette for an early-stage business identity system.

projects.name: Social campaign for a fashion brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her commercial graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions, highlighting her 100+ digital and print creatives and reusable design systems to match Vcom's requirement for branding and collateral production.
omitted: AI-assisted design workflows (stretch: omitted to keep focus strictly on core graphic and visual design execution requested in the posting).
